register_fusion_patches: register runtime fusions for a PreTrainedModel class with a fusion config mapping
build_fused_class: build a fused runtime replacement class from an original nn.Module class using a fusion spec
test_is_fusable: test whether a module is compatible with a fusion family using the is_fusable method
make_transforms: make weight transforms needed to load and save the fused runtime layout from a config
discover_fusable_modules: discover compatible module classes for a fusion family on a meta-initialized model
